table.retrieve:
SELECT	date = purledger.postdate, 
	invcode='PV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), purledger.purinvcode))),
	Postdate = purledger.postdate,
	Due = null, 
	SalePerson=SPACE(100),
	salesman = users.username,
	title = Case  
		When purcatcode = 1 or purcatcode = 2 or purcatcode = 7 or purcatcode = 8  Then 
			(Select accounts.name From accounts
			Where accounts.acccode = purledger.suppcode)
		Else 'Opening Purchase'	End,
	aliasname=customicode,
	item=item.name,
	godown= (select name from godown where gcode=:ar_gcode),
	qty=Case 
		When purledger.purcatcode IN (3,7,8)  THEN
			purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.bonusqty
		ELSE
			purdetail.looseqty + (purdetail.packqty * purdetail.packunits) + (purdetail.bonusqty * purdetail.packunits) 
		END,
	Type= 'IN',
	batch = purdetail.batch,
	expiry=purdetail.expiry,
	rate=Round(Case When purcatcode = 3 or purcatcode = 7 or purcatcode = 8 
				Then purdetail.purprice
				Else purdetail.purprice / purdetail.packunits 
				End, 2),
	discount = purdetail.DiscPerc,
	purdetail.avgprice,
	reference = purledger.remarks,
	UTN=isnull(purdetail.purutn, 0)
from	purledger, purdetail, users, item
where	purledger.Posted = 'Y' and purdetail.gcode=:ar_gcode and
	purledger.postdate between :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate and
	purledger.purinvcode = purdetail.purinvcode and	
	purdetail.icode=item.icode and
	purledger.salesmancode = users.usercode 
UNION
select	date = IssueHeader.date,
	invcode='IS-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), IssueHeader.issueinvcode))),
	Postdate = IssueHeader.postdate,
	Due = null,
	SalePerson=(SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesmanCode=IssueHeader.SManCode),
	salesman = users.username ,
	title = (SELECT department.name from department where department.deptcode=issueheader.deptcode),
	aliasname=customicode,
	item=item.name,
	godown= (select name from godown where gcode=:ar_gcode),
	qty= qty,
	type='OUT',
	batch = Issuedetail.batch,
	expiry=Issuedetail.expiry,
	rate=Round(Issuedetail.purchaseprice, 2),
	discount=0,
	Issuedetail.avgprice,
	reference = issueheader.remarks,
	UTN=isnull(issuedetail.issueutn, 0)
from	Issueheader, issuedetail,users, item
where	issuedetail.gcode=:ar_gcode and
 	issueheader.date between :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate and
	issueheader.issueinvcode = issuedetail.issueinvcode and	
	issuedetail.icode=item.icode and
	issueheader.salesmancode = users.usercode
UNION
select	date = prledger.postdate,
	invcode='PR-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), prledger.prinvcode))),
	Postdate = prledger.date,
	Due = null,
	SalePerson=SPACE(100),
	salesman = users.username ,
	title = Case When prcatcode = 4 or prcatcode = 5 Then (Select accounts.name from accounts where accounts.acccode = prledger.suppcode)
		 	Else 'Opening Purchase Return'
			End,
	aliasname=customicode,
	item=item.name,
	godown= (select name from godown where gcode=:ar_gcode),
	Qty= prdetail.looseqty  + prdetail.bonusqty,
	type='OUT',
	batch = prdetail.batch,
	expiry=prdetail.expiry,
	rate=Round(prdetail.prprice, 2),
	discount=prdetail.discperc,
	prdetail.avgprice,
	reference = prledger.remarks,
	UTN=isnull(prdetail.prutn, 0)
from	prledger, prdetail, users, item
where	prdetail.gcode=:ar_gcode and 
	prledger.postdate between :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate and
	prledger.prinvcode = prdetail.prinvcode and
	prdetail.icode = item.icode and
	prledger.salesmancode = users.usercode
UNION
select	date = saleledger.date,
	invcode=Case  saleledger.salecatcode
		   When  3 Then 'CS-'
		   Else  'CR-'
		End + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), saleledger.saleinvcode))),
	Postdate = saleledger.postdate,
	Due = saledetail.Due,
	SalePerson=(SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesmanCode=saleledger.SManCode),
	salesman = users.username,
	title= Case
		When salecatcode = 1 or salecatcode = 2 Then
			(Select accounts.name from accounts where accounts.acccode = saleledger.custcode)
		Else 'Cash Sale'	End,
	aliasname=customicode,
	item=item.name,
	godown= (select name from godown where gcode=:ar_gcode),
	qtyIn = saledetail.looseqty+saledetail.bonusqty,
	Type='OUT',
	batch = saledetail.batch,
	expiry=saledetail.expiry,
	rate=Round(saledetail.rate, 2),
	discount=saledetail.discperc,
	saledetail.avgprice,
	reference = saleledger.remarks,
	UTN=isnull(saledetail.saleutn,0)
from	saleledger, saledetail, users, item
where	saledetail.gcode = :ar_gcode and
	saleledger.date Between :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate and
	saleledger.saleinvcode = saledetail.saleinvcode and
	saledetail.icode = item.icode and
	saleledger.salesmancode = users.usercode
union
select	date = srledger.postdate,
	invcode= Case  srledger.srcatcode
		   When 8 Then 'CSR-'
		   Else        'CRR-'
		End + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), srledger.srinvcode))),
	Postdate = srledger.postdate,
	Due=null,
	SalePerson=(SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesmanCode=srledger.SManCode),
	salesman = users.username ,
	title= Case When srcatcode = 6 or srcatcode = 7 Then (Select accounts.name from accounts where accounts.acccode = srledger.custcode)
			Else 'Cash Sale Return' End,
	aliasname=customicode,
	item=item.name,
	godown= (select name from godown where gcode=:ar_gcode),
	qty= srdetail.looseqty+srdetail.bonusqty,
	Type= 'IN',
	batch = srdetail.batch,
	expiry=srdetail.expiry,
	rate=Round(srdetail.srprice, 2),
	discount=srdetail.discperc,
	srdetail.avgprice,
	reference = srledger.remarks,
	UTN=isnull(srdetail.srutn, 0)
from	srledger, srdetail, users, item
where	srledger.posted = 'Y' and 
	srdetail.gcode=:ar_gcode and
	srledger.postdate between :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate and
	srledger.srinvcode = srdetail.srinvcode and
	srdetail.icode = item.icode and 
	srledger.salesmancode = users.usercode
union
select 
	date = DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyDate,
	invcode = 'DS-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(10), DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode))),
	Postdate = Null,
	Due = 'A',
	SalePerson=SPACE(100),
	salesman = users.username ,
	Case	When (Select saleledger.salecatcode from saleledger
					Where Saleledger.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode) = 1 
					or(Select saleledger.salecatcode from saleledger
		 		Where Saleledger.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode) = 2 Then 
					(Select accounts.name from accounts, saleledger 
					where Saleledger.saleinvcode = DueSatisfyHeader.saleinvcode  and 
					accounts.acccode = saleledger.custcode)	
			Else 'Cash Sale'	End,
	aliasname=customicode,
	item=item.name,
	godown= (select name from godown where gcode=:ar_gcode),
	qty=DueSatisfyDetail.DueSatisfyqty,
	Type='OUT',
	batch = DueSatisfyDetail.batch,
	expiry=DueSatisfyDetail.expiry,
	rate= Round((select saleprice from saledetail 
		where saledetail.saleinvcode = duesatisfyheader.saleinvcode and 
		saledetail.icode = DueSatisfydetail.icode
		group by icode, saleprice), 2),
	discount = (select DiscPerc from saledetail 
		where saledetail.saleinvcode = duesatisfyheader.saleinvcode and 
		saledetail.icode = DueSatisfydetail.icode
		group by icode, DiscPerc),
	avgprice = (select avgprice from saledetail 
		where saledetail.saleinvcode = duesatisfyheader.saleinvcode and 
		saledetail.icode = DueSatisfydetail.icode
		group by icode, avgprice),
	reference = '               ',
	UTN=isnull(duesatisfydetail.duesatisfyutn, 0)
from	DueSatisfyHeader, DueSatisfydetail, users, item
where	DueSatisfyDetail.gcode = :ar_gcode and
	DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfydate between :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate and
	DueSatisfyHeader.DueSatisfyCode = DueSatisfyDetail.DueSatisfyCode and	
	DueSatisfyDetail.icode = item.icode and
	DueSatisfyHeader.usercode = users.usercode
UNION
select	date = adjheader.posteddate,
	invcode = Case  adjheader.adjcatcode
		   When 1 Then 'AI-'
		   Else        'AD-'
		End + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(10), adjheader.adjcode))),
	Postdate = adjheader.posteddate,
	Due=null,
	SalePerson=SPACE(100),
	salesman = users.username ,
	title= (Select adjcategory.name from adjcategory where adjcategory.adjcatcode = adjheader.adjcatcode),
	aliasname=customicode,
	item=item.name,
	godown= (select name from godown where gcode=:ar_gcode),
	qty = adjdetail.looseqty,
	Type= Case  adjheader.adjcatcode When 2 THEN 'OUT' ELSE 'IN' END,
	batch = adjdetail.batch,
	expiry=adjdetail.expiry,
	rate=Round(adjdetail.price, 2),
	discount=0,
	adjdetail.avgprice,
	reference = adjheader.remarks,
	UTN=adjdetail.adjutn
from	adjheader, adjdetail, users, item
where   adjdetail.gcode = :ar_gcode and
	adjheader.posted = 'Y' and
	adjheader.posteddate between :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate and
	adjheader.adjcode = adjdetail.adjcode and
	adjdetail.icode = item.icode and 
	adjheader.usercode = users.usercode
UNION
select	date = ReceiptHeader.postdate,
	invcode = 'RC' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(10), ReceiptHeader.ReceiptInvCode))),
	Postdate = ReceiptHeader.postdate,
	Due=null,
	SalePerson=(SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesmanCode=ReceiptHeader.SManCode),
	salesman = users.username ,
	title= (Select department.name from department where department.deptcode = ReceiptHeader.deptcode),
	aliasname=customicode,
	item=item.name,
	godown= (select name from godown where gcode=:ar_gcode),
	qty = ReceiptDetail.qty,
	type= 'IN',
	batch = ReceiptDetail.batch,
	expiry=ReceiptDetail.expiry,
	rate=Round(ReceiptDetail.saleprice, 2),
	discount=0,
	ReceiptDetail.avgprice,
	reference = receiptheader.remarks,
	UTN=receiptdetail.receiptutn
from	ReceiptHeader, ReceiptDetail, users, item
where	ReceiptDetail.gcode = :ar_gcode and
	ReceiptHeader.posted = 'Y' and
	ReceiptHeader.postdate between :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate and
	ReceiptHeader.ReceiptInvCode = ReceiptDetail.ReceiptInvCode and
	ReceiptDetail.icode = item.icode and 
	ReceiptHeader.salesmancode = users.usercode
UNION ALL
select	date = THeader.postdate,
	invcode = 'TR-' + RTrim(LTrim(convert(char(10), THeader.TransCode))),
	Postdate = THeader.postdate,
	Due=null,
	SalePerson=(SELECT SM.Name FROM SalesMan SM WHERE SM.SalesmanCode=THeader.SManCode),
	salesman = users.username ,
	title= (Select name from godown 
				where godown.gcode = CASE WHEN THeader.SGCode=:ar_gcode THEN THeader.DGCode 
												  ELSE THeader.SGCODE END),
	aliasname=customicode,
	item=item.name,
	godown= (select name from godown where gcode=:ar_gcode),
	qty = TDetail.qty,
	type= CASE WHEN THeader.SGCode=:ar_gcode THEN 'OUT'
					  ELSE 'IN' END,
	batch = TDetail.batch,
	expiry=TDetail.expiry,
	rate=Round(Item.saleprice/CASE Item.Packunits WHEN 0 THEN 1 ELSE Item.Packunits END, 2),
	discount=0,
	item.avgprice,
	reference = Theader.remarks,
	UTN=Tdetail.Transferutn
from	THeader, TDetail, users, item
where	(Theader.sgcode = :ar_gcode OR Theader.dgcode = :ar_gcode) and
	THeader.posted = 'Y' and
	THeader.postdate between :ar_stdate and :ar_enddate and
	THeader.TransCode = TDetail.TransCode and
	TDetail.icode = item.icode and 
	THeader.salesmancode = users.usercode
table.sort: type A, date A, batch A, expiry A
